blind.description: A small wooden A-frame roosting perch ladder. It features two dark-stained angled side uprights with five horizontal cylindrical wooden rungs, a flat wooden base shelf at the bottom, and diagonal rear support legs. Several scattered white/grey feather or fluff decals are attached to the rungs and baseboard. The surfaces are solid, stylized wood with hand-painted textures.
blind.from_above: A square-to-rectangular wooden frame with five evenly spaced horizontal wooden dowels, a dark wooden shelf underneath, and white feather flakes scattered across the rungs.
blind.height_vs_figure: About half the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure (around 2.5 to 3 ft tall) and roughly 2 ft wide.
